name: KT Seoul / Gwanghwamun IDC
notes: Inflect lists KT Seoul as a data center at 178 Sejong-daero, Jongno-gu; KT's official locations page corroborates the 178 Sejong-daero KT Gwanghwamun West building address. Public MW capacity not found.

name: Zenlayer SEL1
notes: Directory listings place Zenlayer SEL1 at 178 Sejong-daero, Jongno-gu, Seoul, with colocation/network services in the same KT Gwanghwamun building. Capacity not disclosed.

name: KT Hyehwa IDC
notes: Inflect's South Korea data-center index lists KT Hyehwa at Daehakro 65, Jongno-gu, Seoul; OCOLO describes kt IDC as a national IDC operator. Capacity not found in accessible public sources.

name: Zenlayer SEL4
notes: Multiple colocation directories list Zenlayer SEL4 at 65 Daehak-ro, Ihwa-dong/Jongno-gu, Seoul. Capacity not disclosed.

name: TELEHOUSE Seoul
notes: TELEHOUSE's facility sheet places the carrier-neutral Telehouse Seoul data center on the 8th floor of Seoul Finance Center, Taepyeongno 1-ga, Jung-gu; directories corroborate Seoul Financial Center / 136 Sejong-daero. Public MW capacity not found.

name: LG CNS Sangam IT Center
notes: Data Center Map lists LG CNS Sangam IT Center at 424 World Cup buk-ro, Mapo-gu, with 18 MW; KINX's official infrastructure page also identifies the same building as IDC Sangam 1. Capacity is directory-derived.

name: KINX Sangam1 IDC (SA1)
notes: KINX's official data-center page lists IDC Sangam 1 at LG CNS Sangam IT Center, 424 World Cup buk-ro, Mapo-gu, Seoul. Public MW capacity not disclosed by KINX.

name: Samsung SDS Sangam ICT Center
notes: Data Center Map lists Samsung SDS Sangam ICT Center at 24 World Cup buk-ro 60-gil, Mapo-gu, and says it opened in May 2015; KINX's official page identifies the same building as IDC Sangam 2. Capacity not found.

name: KINX Sangam2 IDC (SA2)
notes: KINX's official data-center page lists IDC Sangam 2 at Samsung SDS Sangam IT Center, 24 World Cup buk-ro 60-gil, Mapo-gu, and describes it as a next-generation ICT center for cloud and big data, completed in 2015. Public MW capacity not disclosed.

name: Equinix SL1
notes: Equinix SL1 is listed as part of Samsung SDS Sangam IT Center at 24 World Cup buk-ro 60-gil, Mapo-gu; Data Center Map lists 2 MW and says SL1 is Equinix's first data center in South Korea. Capacity is directory-derived.

name: Digital Realty Seoul ICN10
notes: Digital Realty's Seoul page lists ICN10 at 12 World Cup buk-ro 60-gil, Mapo-gu, with 132,000 sq ft / 12,263 sq m colocation space; Data Center Catalog lists 12 MW power capacity, and Chosun Biz corroborates ICN10 in Sangam-dong, Mapo-gu.

name: SK Broadband Seoul / Seocho IDC
notes: Inflect lists SK Broadband Seoul as a data center at 6 Beobwon-ro 1-gil, Seocho-dong, Seocho-gu; Zenlayer's Seoul location page also lists an SK Broadband site at 6 Bubwonro1-gil, Seocho-gu. Capacity not found.

name: LG Uplus SEOCHO1 / LG Telecom KIDC-1 Center
notes: Directories list LG Uplus SEOCHO1 / LG Telecom KIDC-1 in Seocho-dong/2481 Nambusunhwan-ro, Seocho-gu. Data Center Map lists 9.5 MW; Baxtel lists 41,919 sq m and 3,456 racks. Capacity is directory-derived.

name: Telstra Seoul (SEDS1)
notes: Data Center Map and Inflect list Telstra/Pacnet SEDS1 at 1423-1 Seocho-dong / 2481 Nambusunhwan-ro, Seocho-gu; PeeringDB corroborates the Seocho-gu address. Capacity not found.

name: Zenlayer SEL6 / SK Broadband Seocho
notes: Zenlayer's Seoul location page lists SEL6 at SK Broadband, 6 Bubwonro1-gil, Seocho-gu; this appears to be a Zenlayer node within the SK Broadband Seocho facility. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Kdatacenter Seocho
notes: Data Center Map lists Kdatacenter at 1710-1 Seocho-dong, near the Telstra and SK Broadband Seocho facilities; ColoMap nearby listings reference Netdedi.com SKBB IDC at 1710-1 Seocho-dong. Capacity and operator details are weakly evidenced.
